title: Mornington Tourist Railway – Santa Specials
summary: Special Christmas Santa train rides on Mornington Tourist Railway in December. Steam train journey with visit from Santa. Children can write letters to Santa posted to the North Pole. Christmas carols at Moorooduc Station. Family festive experience on a heritage steam railway.
